Name: Wee Highland Coos
Author: gglacier
Description:
This sprite change replaces brown cows and baby brown cows with adorable, shaggy highland cows!

[b][size=3]Install
[/size][/b]
Backup the following files in your Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew folder:

BabyBrown Cow.xnb
Brown Cow.xnb

Replace the above files with the ones included in this archive.

Any questions or feedback, feel free to ping [url=http://twitter.com/telekineticyeti]@telekineticyeti[/url] on twitter.
